extracted.intended_audience: mystery writers, publishers, industry professionals, and fans of crime/mystery literature and television
extracted.subtask_description: An official announcement listing nominees for the 2026 Edgar Allan Poe Awards (works published or produced in 2025), plus statements about judging and other special awards. The page is primarily a public press release/nomination roster for a single award program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility timeframe
rubrics_metrics.description: honoring the best in mystery fiction, nonfiction and television published or produced in 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The awards and the nominees listed on this page are for works published or produced in the 2025 calendar year (explicitly stated as the eligibility period for the 2026 awards).

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of the Edgar Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Awards ... are presented to authors of distinguished work in various categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards recognize 'distinguished work' in mystery-related categories across fiction, nonfiction, and television; nomination implies selection as among the year's distinguished works in a given category.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST NOVEL
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for the year's top mystery novel (nominees listed). Implicit eligibility: published in 2025 and considered among the best mystery novels of that year.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST FIRST NOVEL BY AN AMERICAN AUTHOR
rubrics_metrics.description: BEST FIRST NOVEL BY AN AMERICAN AUTHOR
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category title indicates eligibility limited to a first novel and to American authors; nominees listed are first novels by American authors published in 2025.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST PAPERBACK ORIGINAL
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for works first released as paperback originals (nominees listed). Implicit: paperback-original format and 2025 publication eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST FACT CRIME
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category recognizing the year's best true-crime nonfiction books (nominees listed). Implicit: nonfiction true-crime works published in 2025.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST CRITICAL/BIOGRAPHICAL
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for critical studies and biographies related to crime/mystery (nominees listed). Implicit: published in 2025 and addresses critical/biographical subjects in the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST SHORT STORY
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for outstanding short mystery fiction (nominees listed with original publication venues and dates). Implicit eligibility: short stories published in 2025 in magazines/anthologies/online venues.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST JUVENILE
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for mystery books aimed at juvenile readers (nominees listed). Implicit: targeted age/market (juvenile) and published in 2025.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST YOUNG ADULT
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for mystery books aimed at young adult readers (nominees listed). Implicit: YA market and 2025 publication eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST TELEVISION EPISODE TELEPLAY
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category recognizing individual television episode teleplays (nominees listed with episode titles, series, and credited teleplay writers). Implicit eligibility: teleplays produced/broadcast in 2025.

rubrics_metrics.name: ROBERT L. FISH MEMORIAL AWARD
rubrics_metrics.description: ROBERT L. FISH MEMORIAL AWARD – Endowed by the family of Robert L. Fish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed nominees are short fiction pieces; the award is a memorial prize named for Robert L. Fish. (Page lists specific short-story nominees and venues—implicit criteria: short-story form and publication in 2025.)

rubrics_metrics.name: THE SIMON & SCHUSTER MARY HIGGINS CLARK AWARD
rubrics_metrics.description: THE SIMON & SCHUSTER MARY HIGGINS CLARK AWARD – Presented on behalf of Simon & Schuster.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An award presented in partnership with a sponsoring publisher; nominees listed. Implicit: category has sponsor-specific naming and eligibility tied to the sponsor's established criteria (here, likely suspenseful, traditional-mystery novels published in 2025).

rubrics_metrics.name: THE G.P. PUTNAM’S SONS SUE GRAFTON MEMORIAL AWARD
rubrics_metrics.description: THE G.P. PUTNAM’S SONS SUE GRAFTON MEMORIAL AWARD – Presented on behalf of G.P. Putnam’s Sons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A memorial award presented on behalf of a sponsoring house; nominees listed. Implicit: award honors a body/style associated with Sue Grafton or similar criteria and covers works published in 2025.

rubrics_metrics.name: THE LILIAN JACKSON BRAUN MEMORIAL AWARD
rubrics_metrics.description: THE LILIAN JACKSON BRAUN MEMORIAL AWARD – Endowed by the estate of Lilian Jackson Braun.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A memorial named award with listed nominees. Implicit criteria: tied to the legacy/style/genre facets associated with Lilian Jackson Braun and publication in the eligibility year.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPECIAL AWARDS – GRAND MASTER, RAVEN, ELLERY QUEEN
rubrics_metrics.description: SPECIAL AWARDS (PREVIOUSLY ANNOUNCED) — GRAND MASTER; RAVEN AWARD; ELLERY QUEEN AWARD
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special honors distinct from category-based Edgars: Grand Master is a lifetime achievement; Raven Award (given to institutions/individuals for outstanding service to mystery field); Ellery Queen Award (industry contribution). Page lists honorees (Donna Andrews; Lee Child; Book Passage; John Scognamiglio). These are discretionary honors rather than single-work categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging fairness and diversity
rubrics_metrics.description: Mystery Writers of America would like to emphasize our commitment to diversity and fairness in judging of the Edgar Awards. Judges are selected from every region of the country, from every sub-category of our genre, and from every demographic to ensure fairness and impartiality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit organizational commitment: judges are chosen to represent geographic regions, sub-categories of the genre, and diverse demographics to reduce bias and ensure impartiality in selection of nominees and winners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nomination as recognition within sub-categories
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgars are presented to authors of distinguished work in various categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Placement of works into specific named categories (novel, short story, fact crime, juvenile, YA, teleplay, memorial awards, etc.) indicates that evaluation is performed within discrete sub-categories rather than across the entire field; being nominated signals distinction within that category.
